research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cornami is researching reconfigurable processor circuit architecture and reconfigurable arithmetic engine circuits with input reordering queues, multiplier shifter and combiner networks, and accumulator and control logic to support massively parallel processing arrays. It is also developing reconfigurable reduced instruction set computer processor architecture and methods and apparatus for configuring a reduced instruction set computer to execute fully homomorphic encryption logic gates. These efforts center on advanced core architectures and secure, high performance computation.

overview_description.description: CORMANI is a high performance computing (HPC) company that increases compute performance significantly, made possible by the development of its breakthrough and patented multi-core technology that efficiently uses heterogeneous cores in a highly concurrent, parallel manner. This technology will reduce the use of power sources and lower latency, while vastly increasing the compute performance of products and their ROI in a variety of markets, with the Company’s initial focus being Big Data.

about_short_description.short_description: Cornami is a high-performance computing company that develops break-through computing architecture for real-time environments.

product.name: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) Encrypted Computation
product.description: Hardware-accelerated computation on encrypted data, allowing workloads to run end to end without decrypting inputs or outputs. Designed for privacy-sensitive analytics, AI, cryptography, and regulated workloads.

product.name: MX64 System
product.description: A rack-scale acceleration system that combines Cornami Tigris ASICs, software, and workload mapping for turnkey deployment of encrypted and other specialized compute workloads.

product.name: Tigris Silicon
product.description: A production ASIC for AI, signal processing, cryptography, and encrypted computation, supporting IEEE-754 floating-point and integer workloads on a reconfigurable compute fabric.

product.name: FracTLcore® Fabric
product.description: A reconfigurable compute fabric composed of compute units with private local memory, compiler-controlled operator-level reconfiguration, SRAM, and multilevel interconnects.

product.name: TruStream® Model
product.description: A stream-centric programming model for expressing workloads as dataflow graphs and executing them continuously with compiler-managed data reuse and portability across hardware generations.

identifier.value: Application-Specialized Compute Engineering and Workload Mapping

product.name: Application-Specialized Compute Engineering and Workload Mapping
product.description: End-to-end engineering services that combine custom silicon, system software, topology design, and workload mapping to deploy specialized compute applications in production.
